mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
